What the Premium package includes

This sample shows the extra features in the Premium package. This panel is for the demo and would not appear on a live site.

  1. 1A signature scroll effect: a necklace that assembles as you scroll
  2. 2A looping hero video with a pause button
  3. 3A Collections gallery you can update yourself (one simple file plus photos)
  4. 4A piercing page with an appointment request form (disabled in this demo)
  5. 5Google rating, review button, map and directions
  6. 6Tap-to-call on every page
